findings.title: Free-form residual wording defeats candidate recurrence
findings.why_it_matters: Artifact-only prose edits must not create a fresh architecture identity and re-enable an otherwise recurrent challenge loop.
findings.what_is_wrong: candidate_fingerprint hashed residual_rationale_or_backlog_ref verbatim, so changing only “now enforces” to “enforces” changed the candidate fingerprint even though every structured score, disposition, blocker, finding, lens, and source root was identical.

findings.leverage_impact: One canonical payload controls recurrence for every success candidate.
findings.locality_impact: A free-form explanation was acting as structured workflow identity.
findings.metric_signal: A one-word rationale edit changed the canonical 32-hex recurrence fingerprint.
findings.why_weakens_submission: The loop can evade its recurrence guard through harmless prose rewording and repeatedly spend independent-challenge cycles on the same architecture.
findings.minimal_correction_path: Hash residual_blocker_kind instead of free-form rationale, retain the structured score/disposition/blocker fields, and assert rationale rephrasing is invariant while blocker-kind changes are not.
